name: RAHUL BHALLA
headline: Co-Founder, Advisory Services | Board Member | Entrepreneur | AI & Tech Executive in Strategy, Transformation & Growth
location: New York, New York, United States
about:
10+ years at the forefront of enterprise technology and transformation, I’ve been driven by one mission: turning technology into intelligent, outcome-driven systems that actually move the business forward—not static implementations, but adaptive, AI-enabled capabilities that evolve with the enterprise.
 
I’ve learned early that transformation doesn’t fail because of technology—it fails when technology leads without context. Real impact happens when business intent, operating models, and execution discipline converge around measurable outcomes. Across hundreds of enterprise programs, the pattern is consistent: it’s not scale or spend that wins—it’s clarity, accountability, and precision in execution.
 
Today, my focus is firmly on AI-first enterprise transformation, intelligent automation, and building next-generation digital and ERP ecosystems that help organizations operate with speed, intelligence, and control at scale.
 
I am actively building and advising in the space where AI, ERP, and enterprise strategy intersect—helping organizations modernize core systems, unlock operational intelligence, and accelerate growth through data-driven decisioning and automation.
 
Alongside this, I work closely with startups and investors as an advisor and board member, supporting founders and leadership teams in refining strategy, scaling execution, and building AI-ready businesses. My global experience spans the US, Canada, Latin America, EU and Asia, across transformation, M&A strategy, supply chain reinvention, and fintech innovation.
 
If you’re building, scaling, or transforming toward an AI-first enterprise, I’m always open to connecting.

experiences.description:
Co-founded and lead RHL Enterprise as a boutique advisory and transformation partner focused on AI-driven enterprise modernization, ERP transformation, and intelligent value realization. Positioned the firm as an outcome-led partner helping clients bridge strategy and execution across process, data, people, and technology.
 
Focused on delivering a customer-centric, value-based transformation approach that translates AI and ERP investments into measurable business outcomes. Built a differentiated engagement model centered on clarity of vision, execution discipline, and continuous value delivery.
 
Responsible for shaping and scaling RHL Enterprise’s advisory and delivery capabilities across AI, ERP, and enterprise transformation services, enabling organizations to modernize core systems and adopt intelligent, data-driven operating models.
 
Key responsibilities include:
 
 - Defining and driving AI + ERP-led enterprise transformation strategy 
 - Leading advisory engagements across digital and business transformation programs 
 - Orchestrating process, data, and tech for value creation
 - Building executive-level client relationships across global markets 
 - Developing scalable delivery frameworks for ERP and AI-enabled solutions 
 - Driving innovation in intelligent automation and enterprise modernization 
 - Supporting growth through strategic partnerships and ecosystem alignment
